title: Alert policy
description: Which sources and classes page a human, which are only recorded, and which go into the daily digest.

modes.heading: What a mode does
modes.RECORD_ONLY: records the incident and raises no alert.
modes.DIGEST: records the incident and lists it in the daily e-mail.
modes.default: A source or class with no row is ALERT. A family whose alerting switch is off raises nothing, whatever its policy.
modes.precedence: The most specific row applies: a source over its class, one console over all consoles, one detector over all detectors.

table.heading: Policies
table.label: Alert policies
table.caption: Alert policy rows: what each source or class governs, the family and detector, and the mode
table.outageNote: A record-only outage policy wins; this policy can only digest or alert a silence the outage policy still pages.

empty.title: Every source alerts as before (default ALERT).
empty.text: No policy row exists, so no source or class is recorded only or digested.

readOnly: Changing a policy needs the admin:outage permission. This table is read-only for your account.

flash.removed: Removed the policy for {name}, {detector}. It now follows a broader policy or the default (ALERT).
flash.gone: That policy row was already removed by someone else. The list has been refreshed.
